subject: Post-call recap — schedule demo + confirm attendee roster
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@carebridge.health>, Tom Wu <tom.wu@carebridge.health>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap — schedule demo + confirm attendee roster

Hi Lena / Tom —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we come prepared for the next session: 

- Primary use case: real-time triage assistant for nurse intake flows (short, low-latency completions; embeddings for chart search)
- Key constraints: PHI handling, VPC/private deployment for production, and predictable P99 latency targets
- Success metrics you mentioned: 2–3s response for common prompts, <10% error on retrieval precision, and a path to 30% token-cost savings vs current baseline

Requested next step: run a technical deep dive/demo focused on an end-to-end path (integration, security controls we support, and live perf snapshots). To align calendars, can you confirm which of these slots work on your side? Times below are PT: 

- Tue 2027-05-17, 10:00–11:00 PT — technical deep dive + SRE Q&A
- Wed 2027-05-18, 09:00–10:00 PT — demo + integration mapping (shorter Q&A)

Proposed attendees from our side: Monica (Solutions Eng), Aditya (Sales Eng), and me. Please let us know which of the two slots fits your team and who from CareBridge should join (engineering, security, procurement).

I've attached a short one-pager and a draft mutual action plan so we can start aligning deliverables. Once you confirm the slot I’ll send a calendar invite with the bridge.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_onepager.pdf (PDF), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (Excel)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena@carebridge.health>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@carebridge.health>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 18:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — schedule demo + confirm attendee roster

Thanks Karthik — great summary, appreciate the clarity.

We do want the deep dive to include our SRE and a representative from Security (to cover PHI/data residency). Tentative attendees from our side: me, Tom (engineering lead), Ravi Patel (SRE), and Priya Anand (Security).

Of the two slots you proposed, Tue 2027-05-17 at 10:00 PT looks best for us. Can you send a calendar invite with a Meet link instead of Zoom (our security team prefers Meet for initial calls)? Also can you add a 10–15 minute agenda at the top of the invite so Ravi knows when to drop off?

One quick ask before the call: could you include a short slide or note on where logs and audit trails live for Private deployments (KMS and audit log retention policies)? If you prefer, Monica can cover that on the call.

Thanks — Lena
Lena Ortiz
VP, Product — CareBridge Health
lena@carebridge.health | 212-555-0199

Karthik
